title: Platinum Notes 10 template effective-state interchange contract
description: Research contract, not an implementation or a claim of DSP equivalence. Values represent effective PNTemplate fields after legacy XML parsing and setter effects, not raw XML literals. Float values are exact IEEE-754 binary32 bits encoded as eight hexadecimal digits prefixed by 0x; this represents endpoints, signed zero, and non-finite bit patterns in JSON. The consumer must not infer UI constraints as parser validation. Native GUI export clones the selected template to a new ID, clears its default flag, and serializes floats lossily; this contract does not claim native XML is identity- or precision-preserving.

f32.description: IEEE-754 binary32 bits in big-endian hexadecimal notation; e.g. 0x00000000 is +0.0 and 0x80000000 is -0.0.

i64.description: Signed 64-bit integer encoded as decimal text; reject values outside the i64 range.

bands.description: Ordered band 1 through band 4, including all fields even if the effect is disabled.

crossovers.description: Ordered midpoint12, midpoint23, midpoint34 in Hz, after ordered native setter effects.

unique_id.description: Exact legacy uniqueId attribute. Native XML parsing overwrites the constructor UUID with the attribute value, including nil when absent. Preserve any existing spelling; do not generate a replacement merely while importing.

is_default.description: Serialized flag; manager fallback uses first template rather than searching this flag.

low.description: Effective clipThresholdVolumeLow, after XML conversion and coupled setters.

high.description: Effective clipThresholdVolumeHigh, after XML conversion and coupled setters.

threshold_cents.description: XML PitchCents is first parsed by NSString intValue then sign-extended; native storage is signed long.

option.description: PitchType. UI selectedIndex 0 preserves tempo; 1 is turntable-style.

exciter_option.description: Raw effective ExciterOption, not legacy ExciterEnabled or ExciterPreset. Typical options: -1 none, 0 gentle, 2 hot; retain other signed values rather than collapsing them.

limiter_threshold.description: Effective PN volumeLimiterThreshold, after XML +1/clamp and piecewise transform.

character.description: Raw volumeLimiterCharacter; do not conflate the archived UI label with its tag.

limiter_release.description: Native constructor initializes 3.0. This field is used in processing but is not XML-serialized or copied; loading or duplicating a template restores 3.0.
